This booklet lists each available metric, its data source, description, and simplified labels.

## Enrollment in GLASS (GLASS)

**Description:** Country enrollment status in GLASS AMR surveillance.

**Simplified labels:** Enrolled, Not Enrolled

## Data Submission to GLASS (GLASS)

**Description:** Whether enrolled countries have submitted GLASS data.

**Simplified labels:** Submitted, No Submission, Not Enrolled

## National Coordinating Centre (GLASS 2023)

**Description:** Status of AMR national coordinating centre.

**Simplified labels:** Yes, Partial, No, Not Enrolled

## AMR National Reference Lab (GLASS 2023)

**Description:** Status of AMR national reference laboratory.

**Simplified labels:** Yes, No, Not Enrolled

## EQA to NRL (GLASS 2023)

**Description:** External quality assessment provision to the national reference laboratory.

**Simplified labels:** Yes, No, Not Enrolled

## AST Standards in Use (GLASS 2023)

**Description:** Whether AST standards are defined/reported.

**Simplified labels:** Yes, Not Enrolled

## EQA at GLASS Labs (GLASS 2023)

**Description:** Extent of EQA coverage across GLASS laboratories.

**Simplified labels:** Yes, Partial, Not Enrolled

## AMR National Reference Lab (TrACSS)

**Description:** TrACSS-reported NRL AST capacity (all organisms, some organisms, or none).

**Simplified labels:** Yes, Partial, No

## Surveillance Network (TrACSS)

**Description:** Maturity of national AMR surveillance network in TrACSS.

**Simplified labels:** Yes, Partial, No
